title: trigger.create
description: Create new triggers. The trigger expression has to be given in its expanded form.

event_name.description: Event name generated by the trigger.

priority.description: Severity of the trigger. Possible values are: 0 - (default) not classified; 1 - information; 2 - warning; 3 - average; 4 - high; 5 - disaster.

status.description: Whether the trigger is enabled or disabled. Possible values are: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

type.description: Whether the trigger can generate multiple problem events. Possible values are: 0 - (default) do not generate multiple events; 1 - generate multiple events.

recovery_mode.description: OK event generation mode. Possible values are: 0 - (default) Expression; 1 - Recovery expression; 2 - None.

correlation_mode.description: OK event closes. Possible values are: 0 - (default) All problems; 1 - All problems if tag values match.

manual_close.description: Allow manual close. Possible values are: 0 - (default) No; 1 - Yes.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported triggers to already existing ones. Used only for triggers on templates. Auto-generated, if not given.

dependencies.description: Triggers that the trigger is dependent on. The triggers must have the triggerid property defined.

triggerid.description: ID of the trigger that this trigger depends on.
